factual predecessor J5::stage1 completed and successor J5::stage2 was assigned; recursive prediction still has J5::stage1 in_transit

conclusion: H20 stops are dominated by missing new task/stage entities, not by an action-scoring failure alone. The factual action sequence assumes entities already generated by the true simulator; the recursive rule/neural state did not yet generate them. Rule also fails 6/36, so the evaluation harness, not only the neural model, is implicated. No retraining is justified by this evidence.
